title: Real Madrid deny accepting Vinicius bid
cleaned_content: Real Madrid issued an official statement denying that any offer for Vinicius Junior had been accepted. The club said recent transfer reports were inaccurate and that the player remains part of their plans.

title: Arsenal open talks over striker signing
cleaned_content: Arsenal have opened talks to sign Viktor Gyokeres after internal meetings earlier this week. Sporting are aware of the interest, but no formal bid has been accepted. The player is understood to be open to a move if the clubs agree a fee.

title: Barcelona confirm defender injury setback
cleaned_content: Barcelona confirmed that Ronald Araujo suffered a hamstring injury during training on Tuesday. Club doctors will monitor his recovery, and early estimates suggest he could miss three weeks of action.

title: Manchester United schedule preseason friendly
cleaned_content: Manchester United will face Celtic in a preseason friendly in Dublin next month. The club said ticket details would be released on Friday, while Erik ten Hag expects several academy players to be involved.

title: UEFA sets date for Champions League draw
cleaned_content: UEFA announced that the Champions League group stage draw will take place in Monaco on Thursday evening. Manchester City and Bayern Munich are among the clubs already qualified for the competition.
